## 1.0 Data Processing. The code below helps to turn the downloaded files into a row / region / day in an rds file.

## 1.1. PM2.5 changed from hourly to daily.

```{r}
source(here("rebuild_data.R"))
pm_long  <- build_pm_long(here("data_raw", "pm25"))
saveRDS(pm_long, here("data_processed", "pm_long.rds"))
pm_daily <- build_pm_daily(pm_long, min_hours = 18)
```

## 1.2. Fire detection is changed to match GMT +8. Zones are also specified in this code.

```{r}
haversine_km <- function(lat, lon, lat0 = 1.35, lon0 = 103.82) {
  r <- pi / 180
  a <- sin((lat - lat0) * r / 2)^2 +
       cos(lat0 * r) * cos(lat * r) * sin((lon - lon0) * r / 2)^2
  6371 * 2 * asin(sqrt(a))
}

fire <- read_csv(here("data_raw", "firms", "fire_archive_SV-C2_854993.csv"),
                 col_types = cols(acq_time = col_character(),
                                  confidence = col_character())) |>
  filter(confidence != "l", type == 0) |>   # drop low confidence, keep vegetation fires
  mutate(ts_utc = ymd_hm(paste(acq_date, str_pad(acq_time, 4, pad = "0")), tz = "UTC"),
         date = as_date(with_tz(ts_utc, "Asia/Singapore")),
         side = if_else(longitude < 106, "w", "e"),
         ring = cut(haversine_km(latitude, longitude), c(0, 500, 1000, Inf),
                    labels = c("near", "mid", "far")),
         zone = paste(side, ring, sep = "_"))

fire_daily <- fire |>
  group_by(date, zone) |>
  summarise(n = n(), frp = sum(frp), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = c(n, frp), values_fill = 0) |>
  complete(date = seq(ymd("2016-12-01"), ymd("2024-12-31"), by = "day")) |>
  mutate(across(-date, ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

## 1.3. Weather processing, combines all the CSV files together and makes sure that the data is properly setup.

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(janitor); library(lubridate); library(here)

station_region <- c(S24 = "east", S44 = "west", S109 = "north",
                    S116 = "south", S111 = "central")

files <- list.files(here("data_raw", "mss"),
                    pattern = "^S\\d+_\\d{6}(\\.csv)?$", full.names = TRUE)

# Sanity check: every station should have 97 monthly files (Dec 2016 - Dec 2024)
tibble(f = basename(files)) |>
  mutate(station = str_extract(f, "^S\\d+")) |>
  count(station)

# Skip failed downloads (empty files or HTML error pages)
is_mss_csv <- function(f) {
  file.size(f) > 0 &&
    str_detect(readLines(f, n = 1, warn = FALSE, encoding = "latin1"), "Station")
}
bad <- files[!map_lgl(files, is_mss_csv)]
message(length(bad), " unusable files: ", paste(basename(bad), collapse = ", "))

read_mss <- function(f) {
  d <- read_csv(f, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                na = c("", "-", "\u2014", "NA")) |>
    clean_names()
  pick <- function(pattern) {
    col <- str_subset(names(d), pattern)[1]
    if (is.na(col)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(d)) else d[[col]]
  }
  tibble(
    station   = str_extract(basename(f), "^S\\d+"),
    date      = make_date(as.integer(d$year), as.integer(d$month), as.integer(d$day)),
    rain      = parse_number(pick("daily_rainfall_total")),
    temp_mean = parse_number(pick("^mean_temp")),
    temp_max  = parse_number(pick("^max.*temp")),
    wind_mean = parse_number(pick("^mean_wind")),
    wind_max  = parse_number(pick("^max.*wind"))
  )
}

weather_raw <- files[map_lgl(files, is_mss_csv)] |> map_dfr(read_mss)

weather_clean <- weather_raw |>
  distinct(station, date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    rain      = if_else(between(rain, 0, 300), rain, NA_real_),       # mm/day
    temp_mean = if_else(between(temp_mean, 20, 35), temp_mean, NA_real_),
    temp_max  = if_else(between(temp_max, 20, 40), temp_max, NA_real_),
    wind_mean = if_else(between(wind_mean, 0, 60), wind_mean, NA_real_), # km/h
    wind_max  = if_else(between(wind_max, 0, 150), wind_max, NA_real_),
    region    = station_region[station]
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(region), !is.na(date))

# Completeness: share of days present per station-year
weather_clean |>
  group_by(station, year = year(date)) |>
  summarise(across(c(rain, temp_mean, wind_mean), ~ mean(!is.na(.x))), .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = Inf)

weather_daily <- weather_clean |>
  select(region, date, rain, temp_mean, temp_max, wind_mean, wind_max)

# Sensitivity version: island-wide daily average across the five stations
weather_island <- weather_clean |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(across(rain:wind_max, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(-date, ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))

saveRDS(weather_daily, here("data_processed", "weather_daily.rds"))
```

## 1.4. Join the data, add features and merge. We define T_HIGH here.

```{r}
monsoon <- function(m) case_when(m %in% c(12, 1, 2, 3) ~ "NE", m %in% 6:9 ~ "SW",
                                 TRUE ~ "inter")

analysis <- pm_daily |>
  complete(region, date = seq(ymd("2016-12-01"), ymd("2024-12-31"), by = "day")) |>
  left_join(weather_daily, by = c("region", "date")) |>
  left_join(fire_daily, by = "date") |>
  arrange(region, date) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(
    pm25_next  = lead(pm25, 1),                        # target (day d+1)
    pm25_lag1  = lag(pm25, 1),
    pm25_roll3 = slider::slide_dbl(pm25, mean, na.rm = TRUE, .before = 2),
    across(starts_with(c("n_", "frp_")),
           list(roll3 = ~ slider::slide_dbl(.x, sum, .before = 2),
                roll7 = ~ slider::slide_dbl(.x, sum, .before = 6)))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(pm25_roll3 = if_else(is.nan(pm25_roll3), NA_real_, pm25_roll3),
         doy_sin = sin(2 * pi * yday(date) / 365.25),
         doy_cos = cos(2 * pi * yday(date) / 365.25),
         monsoon = monsoon(month(date)),
         year    = year(date)) |>
  filter(year >= 2017, !is.na(pm25_next))

# --- Threshold rule from Step 0, using training years (2017-2023) only ---
n_high_train <- function(thr) sum(analysis$pm25_next[analysis$year <= 2023] > thr)
T_HIGH <- if (n_high_train(37.5) >= 50) 37.5 else 25
message("T_HIGH = ", T_HIGH, " µg/m³ (", n_high_train(T_HIGH),
        " high region-days in 2017-2023)")
saveRDS(T_HIGH, here("data_processed", "T_HIGH.rds"))

analysis <- analysis |>
  mutate(high_next = factor(pm25_next > T_HIGH, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                            labels = c("high", "normal")))

saveRDS(analysis, here("data_processed", "analysis.rds"))
```

## 2.0 Exploratory Analysis of 2017-2023 as the training set.

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(here)
train <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "analysis.rds")) |> filter(year <= 2023)

train |>
  ggplot(aes(date, pm25, colour = region)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = T_HIGH, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily mean PM2.5 (µg/m³)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig1_timeseries.png"), width = 8, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

train |> count(year, region, high_next) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = high_next, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```
